description: Lightwell OSV datasource for Renovate — enables Renovate to consume Lightwell remediated versions for simple dependency updates. Complex cases (code migration, build failures) go to the ADK agent instead.

packageRules.description: For packages available in Lightwell remediated repo, check Lightwell first
Auto-merge Lightwell .rhlw patches when tests pass (opt-in via remediation plan)

hostRules.description: Lightwell registry authentication — set LIGHTWELL_USERNAME and LIGHTWELL_TOKEN in Renovate env

_comment: This configuration enables Renovate to discover Lightwell .rhlw versions.
For simple version pins where no code changes are needed, Renovate handles it.
For complex cases (API migration, build failure diagnosis), the ADK agent handles it.
The automerge flag is false by default — set to true per the RemediationPlan policy.
See also: lw-agents/app/tools/lightwell_tools.py for the agent-side implementation.
